title: 100 Days of Deception
cast: Kim Yoo Jung, Park Jin Young, Kim Hyun Joo, Lee Moo Saeng, Jin Sun Kyu
summary: A period spy romance following skilled pickpocket Lee Ga Kyeong, who takes on an undercover mission for the independence movement and becomes entangled with interpreter Kim Tae Woong.
trailerLabel: Official Netflix title page / available trailer
whyFans: The historical spy premise blends romance with an undercover mission inside the colonial government.
The lead's resourcefulness and language skills give her a reason to enter a dangerous assignment.
Personal relationships sit alongside a wider struggle for Korean independence.
review: 100 Days of Deception combines a historical setting with espionage and a complicated romance. The undercover mission creates a natural source of suspense, while shifting identities put trust under pressure. Its strongest moments should come when the political stakes and the characters' personal loyalties collide.
